speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal listeriosis (maternal listeriosis).

Given your recent consumption of ice cream and current symptoms at 30 weeks gestation, these findings are highly suggestive of *Listeria monocytogenes* infection. I will be monitoring your temperature and blood work closely to confirm this and start treatment immediately.
